title: Interaction of Br with Cu(100) surface: adsorption and thermodynamics stability study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28384-28394
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02406D, Paper

Ali Marashdeh, Sherin A. Saraireh, Niveen W. Assaf, Suzan K. Alghamdi, Akef T. Afaneh, Wissam Helal, Mohammednoor Altarawneh
Inclusion of van der Waals corrections significantly enhances the binding energies of Br on the Cu(100) surface, with higher Br chemical potential promoting more stable Br/Cu(100) configurations, among which the hollow site at 0.75 ML coverage is the most favorable.
